artifact.name: Checkout — payment step
artifact.primary_task: Enter payment and place the order
artifact.notes: Playwright sweep across the breakpoint ladder; axe-core + Lighthouse run on Chromium and WebKit.

states.notes: could not trigger expiry in staging

summary.short_rationale: Strong layout and contrast, but focus is lost when the payment iframe loads and the order summary overflows horizontally at 320px. Capped at 3/5 until both are fixed.

checks.notes: Order summary causes horizontal scroll at 320px.
Focus drops to body when the hosted card iframe mounts.
All text >= 4.5:1 in light and dark.
Edit-link targets are 22px; below the 24px minimum.
Focus ring and field borders survive forced-colors.

findings.title: Focus lost when payment iframe mounts

evidence.description: Tabbing into the payment step moves focus to body when the hosted card iframe hydrates; keyboard users land nowhere.

findings.impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot find the card field after the step loads.
findings.recommendation: Move focus to the payment step heading on mount, and ensure the iframe is reachable in tab order before it hydrates.

findings.title: Order summary overflows at 320px

evidence.description: The order-summary table forces horizontal scrolling at 320px, violating WCAG 1.4.10.

findings.impact: Small-viewport users must scroll horizontally to read totals.
findings.recommendation: Stack the summary into label/value rows below 480px; cap the table to the viewport width.

findings.title: Edit links below 24px

evidence.description: Inline 'Edit' links in the summary measure 22px tall.

findings.impact: Harder to tap accurately on coarse pointers.
findings.recommendation: Increase the hit area to 24px minimum (44px on coarse pointers).

unverified.reason: Session expiry could not be triggered in staging.
unverified.needed_evidence: A way to force token expiry, or a recording of the expired-session path.

unverified.reason: Gecko was not in scope for this sweep.

recommendations.title: Restore focus on payment step
recommendations.action: Manage focus on iframe mount and verify with a keyboard pass.
recommendations.success_criteria: Tab order reaches the card field; focus never lands on body.
